reasons.U1: Only a pre-game state with '규칙 3줄' plus a help dialog and a '추정치 · 전역 최선 아님' note; no beginner onboarding or first-turn guide on how to read the rings, heatmap and numbers.
reasons.U2: FLOW-002 and SCR-001: tap a cell or a recommendation row to preview details, the 'H8에 두기' confirm button, changing the selection cancels the stale calculation, undo; keeps the existing touch-confirm step and keyboard access.
reasons.U3: Section 3 item 6 puts a collapsible panel below the board on 390x844 with tap-for-detail, and UNK-006/007 note that a 358px board is hard to read and cap suggestions at 3; but what fits on the board at once and the overlap priority are left as owner details.
reasons.U4: FLOW-002 is told from the user's side: look at suggestions and the heatmap, pick a cell, compare win rate, W/L/D and the opponent's replies, place the stone, then the AI auto-replies (FLOW-003).
reasons.R1: UNK-001 puts the definition to the user: simulated estimate with sample size ('200판 중') and the label '추정', alternatives B/C/D, an explicit caveat that it is not the real-game win rate, and the conflict with BRIEF flagged (CON-001); viewpoint is in UNK-009.
reasons.R2: UNK-006 (compute only candidate cells because 225 cells is too slow), UNK-008 (time limit, progressive updates or wait), stale-result cancellation in FLOW-002/004, the 2s worker watchdog, and a plan to actually measure performance on 20 mid-game boards.
reasons.R3: 13 prioritized UNKs (win-rate meaning, the coaching card, AI auto-reply, strength, toggle, review) go to the user one at a time; section 3 limits owner decisions to local, reversible items and says the draft assumes the recommended options.
